integrated_final_evidence_baseline.title: Integrated final-evidence, gate, acceptance, and release-definition baseline
integrated_final_evidence_baseline.statement: The consolidated obligation set that unites every Volume 12 evidence, gate, acceptance, and release-decision model into one integrated baseline recording, per obligation, its source, invariant, required evidence, acceptance authority, gate destination, and current evidence, acceptance, and release status.
integrated_final_evidence_baseline.prohibited_inference: Evidence requirement defined is not evidence produced is not evidence validated is not evidence accepted.

final_evidence_requirements.title: Integrated final-evidence requirement
final_evidence_requirements.statement: The requirement that each obligation in the integrated final-evidence baseline name its authoritative source, required evidence class, provenance, environment, acceptance authority, gate destination, and current evidence, acceptance, and release status.
final_evidence_requirements.prohibited_inference: Evidence requirement defined is not evidence produced is not evidence validated is not evidence accepted.
